subject: Data tab Categoric vs. Numeric in column and in message at bottom

messages.author: c0e8f7316ddfc522
messages.subject: Data tab Categoric vs. Numeric in column and in message at bottom
parts:
On the Data tab, the Data Type column indicates a variable (CAR.MDD)
is Categoric. I highlight the CAR.MDD row, click Numeric for Target
Data Type, and click the Target button for CAR.MDD, and click Execute.

A message appears at the bottom that "The Target is CAR.MDD. Numeric.
Regression models enabled."

OK, I expect that. Good.

Unfortunately, everywhere else -- in the Data Type column on the Data
tab, or on Explore > Distributions, CAR.MDD appears as Categoric.

I need CAR.MDD to be Numeric everywhere.

What am I missing (aside from R savvy)? How do I specify CAR.MDD to
be numeric for every feature?

Best regards,

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Data tab Categoric vs. Numeric in column and in message at bottom
parts:
Hi,

The target override only tells the modelling algorithms to treat the
target as numeric, not everthing else, as you discovered. You can go
to the Transform tab, Recode option, and select As Numeric, then
select CAR.MDD and Execute to transform it into a Numeric (a new
variable is added) for all to see.

Regards,
Graham
